top_performing_topics: Contrarian market analysis (debunking common retail investment strategies)
Wealth erosion awareness (inflation vs. traditional savings instruments)
Asset valuation and market timing (identifying true value vs. traps)
winning_hook_formulas: The 'Warning/Stop' Formula: [Negative Action] + [Specific Financial Instrument] + [Immediate Consequence] (e.g., 'Stop buying [X] before you check [Y]')
The 'Hidden Loss' Formula: [Asset Name] + [Specific Percentage/Number] + [Emotional Impact] (e.g., 'Your [X] is secretly making you poorer every single day')
script_directives: Maintain a strict duration of 20-22 seconds to force high-density information delivery.
Eliminate all fluff; start the hook at 0.0s and introduce the core conflict within the first 3 seconds.
Use high-contrast visual cues (charts or red/green indicators) to emphasize the 'trap' or 'opportunity' mentioned in the hook.
seo_directives: Use high-intent, negative-emotion keywords in titles (e.g., 'Trap', 'Loss', 'Stop', 'Secretly') to trigger curiosity.
Limit hashtags to 3-4 high-relevance tags (e.g., #StockMarketIndia, #PersonalFinance, #InvestingTips) to avoid algorithmic dilution.
